fieldValues.title: Parallel worktrees run e2e against each other's dev server, so a gate judges the wrong branch
fieldValues.summary: Driving holon semanticops.com#49, the driver built srs-web#642 and #643 in parallel worktrees and ran their e2e at the same time. Playwright reuses any server on its fixed port (reuseExistingServer: true, port 5173), so #643's test ran against #642's code and failed on a dialog #643 does not have. A green could equally have been the wrong branch's.
evidence: help-dialog intercepts pointer events in a #643 run, 2026-10-29
fieldValues.body:
- Gates are judged by exit code, so a cross-wired run is a false green or a false red with nothing to show it.
- Workaround used: a PLAYWRIGHT_PORT per worktree. Fix: srs-web#658.
